note: Lean proves the final inequality in one step (via q <= x/(8Q), W <= x/U) rather than through the displayed chain of intermediate fractions.

have hRcond : R ^ 2 ≤ x / (|δ| * q) / (q + x / (4 * W)) := by
    rw [hR2, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have hqx : (q : ℝ) ≤ x / (8 * Q) := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hqW : q * W ≤ x * ε₁ / 4 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hqx hWx hW0.le (by positivity)
      refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      simp only [ε₁]; field_simp; ring
    simp only [c]
    rw [show x / (|δ| * q) * (|δ| * q * (1 + ε₁) / 4) = x * (1 + ε₁) / 4 by field_simp]
    have : W * (q + x / (4 * W)) = q * W + x / 4 := by field_simp; try ring
    rw [this]; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: With c = |delta| q (1 + x/2UQ)/4 and R^2 = W/c, proves R^2 <= (x/|delta q|)/(q + x/4W), using q <= x/8Q and W <= x/U (q W <= x eps_1/4), i.e. x/|delta q| (q + x/4W)^{-1} >= 4W/(|delta| q (1 + x/2UQ)).
